packageRules.description: fiber stays on v2 until qubership-core-lib-go-fiber-server-utils publishes its /v3 module. The management server is built by that library: fiberserver.New takes a fiber v2 Config and its builder returns a fiber v2 App, so the service cannot move to fiber v3 alone. Remove this rule in the change that moves the library and fiber to v3 together.

Jayway JsonPath stays at 2.9.0, one of the versions legacy access-control evaluates its paths with: internal/jsonpath is tested against it, and a newer Jayway is not the behavior the agent has to match. Change it together with the version the legacy service ships, and with the JsonPath checkout in the jsonpath-jayway job of .github/workflows/integration-tests.yaml and internal/jsonpath/testdata/jayway/recorder/pom.xml.

integration-tests.yaml sets up Helm 3 and Helm 4 side by side so the charts are checked on both. The docs support Helm 3.19 or later, so the Helm 3 pin takes only 3.19.x patch releases: a move to a later Helm 3 would leave the oldest supported minor untested, and a move to Helm 4 would leave Helm 3 untested.
The Helm 4 pins take every Helm 4 release, so they stay on the latest 4.x; a Helm 5 is a new pin next to these, not an update of them.
The OPA CLI in mise.toml runs the Rego tests, so it stays at the version of the OPA library that go.mod pins: one pull request updates both, and the tests run on the evaluator the agent embeds.
